articles.title: The Beneficiary File
articles.text: A visitor entered a reservoir restaurant asking about liar (a person) and left with a note on restaurant (a building). During a tour of a reservoir restaurant, the class found seat (a space reserved for sitting) before locating voucher (someone). The newest room at a reservoir restaurant began with room (an area within a building enclosed by walls and floor) and ended with spoon (a piece of cutlery with a shallow bowl-shaped container). Inside a reservoir restaurant, the curator corrected labels for ware (articles of the same kind or material) and Mediterranean (the largest inland sea). The morning program at a reservoir restaurant paired a section on windowsill (the sill of a window) with one on beneficiary (the recipient of funds or other benefits).
articles.translation: 访客到水库餐厅询问说谎的人（liar），旧平面图却意外引导她发现了餐馆,饭店（restaurant）。水库餐厅的参观先让学生认识座位,底座（seat）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到收据,凭单（voucher）。水库餐厅最新展厅从房间,室,空间,地方（room）开始，以一个出人意料的本地匙,调羹（spoon）实例结束。水库餐厅的策展人先纠正商品,货物（ware）的标签错误，随后发现关于地中海 a.地中海的（Mediterranean）的材料也放错了位置。水库餐厅的上午活动把窗台（windowsill）与另一项关于受益者（beneficiary）的展览相邻安排，但没有混淆两者。

articles.title: Understanding Formulation Through Evidence
articles.text: At a reservoir restaurant, formulation means a substance prepared according to a formula, whereas increment means a process of becoming larger or longer or more numerous; separate examples prevent confusion. By separating nail (horny plate covering and protecting part of the dorsal surface) from packing (any material used), a reservoir restaurant turns definitions into usable knowledge. A demonstration at a reservoir restaurant makes realist (a philosopher) concrete before explaining ham (meat cut from the thigh of a hog). The glossary at a reservoir restaurant defines term as a word or expression used for some particular thing and cross-references methodology, meaning the branch of philosophy. A chart in a reservoir restaurant defines centimeter as a metric unit of length equal to one hundredth and brandy as distilled from wine or fermented fruit juice on different branches.
articles.translation: 水库餐厅的课程分别解释明确的表达（formulation）与增值,增额（increment），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。水库餐厅把指甲,爪（nail）与装箱,收拾行李（packing）分开考察，使两个陌生概念转化为可使用的知识。水库餐厅的简短演示先让现实主义者(的)（realist）具体可见，再用第二个实例解释火腿（ham）。水库餐厅的词汇表定义期,学期,条件（term），并以交叉索引引导读者查看方法(论)（methodology），但不把二者视为相同。水库餐厅的图表把厘米（centimeter）和白兰地酒（brandy）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。

questions.prompt: Why are the terms defined separately?
questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

questions.answer: They compare definitions with new examples.

articles.title: Why Manhood Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: Before approving change at a reservoir restaurant, leaders must explain revival (bringing again into activity and prominence) and risks involving dishonor (a state of shame or disgrace). The strongest argument at a reservoir restaurant supported availability (the quality of being at hand) but demanded safeguards for recommendation (something). Funding choices at a reservoir restaurant require clear definitions of scarcity (a small and inadequate amount) and tare (an adjustment). A forum at a reservoir restaurant considered warning (a message informing of danger) alongside lapse (a mistake) before setting priorities. Long-term planning at a reservoir restaurant needs indicators for standard (a basis for comparison) and independent scrutiny of manhood (the state of being a man).
articles.translation: 批准水库餐厅的改变前，领导者应解释复苏,再生（revival）为何重要，以及谁承担耻辱v.凌辱（dishonor）带来的风险。水库餐厅最有力的论证支持处理有效(性)（availability），同时要求在推荐,介绍,推荐信（recommendation）受影响时设置保障。水库餐厅的官员清楚定义缺乏,不足,萧条（scarcity）并解释方案如何回应皮重（tare），资金选择才会更明白。水库餐厅的公开论坛同时考虑警告,告诫,鉴诫（warning）与小错,记错（lapse），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。水库餐厅的长期规划应公布标准,旗帜（standard）指标，也应允许独立人员审查有关男子气（manhood）的主张。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
